types.name: Coverage
types.description:
Coverage is a measure for how much of a time period there is valid data for.
 For traffic volume per hour or day, coverage is the ratio of time _with_ valid data to the whole time period.
 For average daily traffic volume, coverage is the average coverage for days with sufficient coverage (>95%),
 multiplied by the ratio of number of days with sufficient coverage (>95%) to the total number of days in the period.

fields.name: percentage
fields.description: Percentage denoting how much of the time period there is valid data for.

fields.name: included
fields.description:
Number of included time units. See also documentation for the `unit` field.
 For example, if a traffic registration point is commissioned at 12 am, that day will only include 12 hours of traffic.
 For an average, this refers to the number of traffic volumes included in the average (i.e. with sufficient coverage).

fields.name: uncertain
fields.description:
Number of uncertain time units. See also documentation for the `unit` field.
 For hours, this is 1/1=100% if the hour has uncertain coverage, and 0/1=0% otherwise.
 For days, this is the ratio of hours with uncertain coverage.
 For an average, this is the number of days with too low coverage to be included in the average.

fields.name: unavailable
fields.description:
Number of unavailable time units. These are units that have not yet been calculated, or are outside the commissioned
 period for the registration point. See also documentation for the `unit` field.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Time unit for included and uncertain fields.

fields.name: fromAccordingToRoadLink
fields.description:
Name of the place you get to by travelling against the road link direction.
 In other words: When lanes are numbered according to the road link direction, then traffic in even-numbered lanes
 is headed towards this place, while traffic in odd-numbered lanes is headed away from this place.
 See also `Lane.laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink`.

fields.name: fromAccordingToMetering
fields.description:
Name of the place you get to by travelling against the current metering direction.
 In other words: When lanes are numbered according to the road's metering direction, then traffic in even-numbered
 lanes is headed towards this place, while traffic in odd-numbered lanes is headed away from this place.
 See also `Lane.laneNumberAccordingToMetering`.
 Warning: The metering direction of the road is subject to change at any time, changing the meaning of this field.
 If you need a value which stays constant over time, use `fromAccordingToRoadLink` instead."

 is headed towards this place, while traffic in even-numbered lanes is headed away from this place.
 See also `Lane.laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink`.

fields.name: laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink
fields.description:
Lane number according to the current road system reference and road link direction
 (as defined by Nasjonal vegdatabank NVDB).
 Lane numbers are ascending from the center line outwards.
 Traffic in odd-numbered lanes travels with the road link direction.
 Traffic in even-numbered lanes travels against the road link direction.
 Note that this is also how lanes are numbered in NVDB.
 Note also that if the metering direction is the same as the road link direction,
 then `laneNumberAccordingToMetering` and `laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink` are equivalent.

fields.name: laneNumberAccordingToMetering
fields.description:
Lane number according to the current road system reference and metering direction
 (as defined by Nasjonal vegdatabank NVDB).
 Lane numbers are ascending from the center line outwards.
 Traffic in odd-numbered lanes travels with the metering direction.
 Traffic in even-numbered lanes travels against the metering direction.
 Note that this is not how lanes are numbered in NVDB. If you need lane numbers which
 match what you get from NVDB, use `laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink` instead.
 Note also that if the metering direction is the same as the road link direction,
 then `laneNumberAccordingToMetering` and `laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink` are equivalent.
 Warning: The metering direction of the road is subject to change at any time, changing the meaning of this field.
 If you need a value which stays constant over time, use `laneNumberAccordingToRoadLink` instead."

fields.name: laneNumber
fields.description:
Lane number.
 Lane numbers are ascending from the center line outwards.
 Odd-numbered lanes are on one side of the center line, even-numbered are on the other side.
